messages.name: AI usage alert
messages.description: Tells the staff once a month when the assistant's AI tokens pass the alert share of the monthly cap.

email.subject: The chat assistant used {percent}% of its AI tokens
email.text: The chat assistant of {business} has used {used} of this month's {cap} AI tokens, more than the {percent}% set for this alert. When the cap is reached, AI replies stop until the month ends.

sms.text: {business} chat: {used} of this month's {cap} AI tokens used (over {percent}%).

messages.name: Chat needs you
messages.description: Tells the staff when a visitor asks for a person (handoff).

email.subject: Chat needs you: {visitor}

sms.text: {visitor} needs a person on the {business} chat: {preview}{?link} {link}{/link}

messages.name: New chat message
messages.description: Tells the staff about a visitor's message: the first unanswered one, or every one (the staff alert setting).

email.subject: New chat message from {visitor}

messages.name: Reply alert to the visitor
messages.description: Tells a visitor who left the chat that the staff replied.

email.subject: {staff} replied to your chat with {business}

messages.name: Chat transcript
